excerpt: Anthropic’s Landmark Copyright Settlement: Implications for AI Developers and Enterprise Users Alert September 8, 2025 6 minutes Authors: Regina Sam Penti , Yam Schaal Overview Anthropic, a leading developer of artificial intelligence large language models (LLMs), has reached a settlement in a closely watched dispute with a class of authors and publishers who alleged copyright infringement arising from Anthropic’s use of copyrighted materials to train its generative AI models.
